description: Read authorized WebFactory data and execute supported changes with explicit OAuth consent.

interface.longDescription: Connect one business or explicitly authorize platform administration. Read commerce and accounting information and execute supported changes directly from ChatGPT when Execute is granted. Sensitive actions require an exact confirmation in the same chat. Private development tools require platform-admin consent. Passwords, credentials and private platform source remain outside this connection.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verifica mi cuenta, alcance, permisos y catálogo autorizado de herramientas de WebFactory.
